description: Historical match-to-price correlation. Ask 'what happens to BAR after Champions League wins?' and get backtested data with price impact percentages. Returns individual match records with price at kickoff, fulltime, +1h, +24h and aggregate stats (avg impact, win rate, best/worst).

limit.description: Number of matches to return (default 20, max 100)
